simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: חַמֹּת דֹּאר (Chammôth Dôʼr) means Chammath-Dor , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 21 32.

definitions.full: H2576. Chammoth Dor דּאֹר חַמֹּת proper name, of a location in Naphtali, Levitical city Josh 21:32 (perhaps = 1. חַמּוֺן חַמַּת, 2 see Di), ᵐ5 Νεμμαθ , A Εμαθδωρ , ᵐ5 L Αμαθδωρ .
definitions.rootNote: from the plural of 2535 and 1756 ; hot springs of Dor;
